capacity_correction: Hot Coal has no owned-child marker. A separate pending-spawn producer tag pauses the producer while an already selected volley cannot be admitted, bounding its retained queue to one volley without replacing the source population rule. Regression held Coal Boy at one admitted parent for1000ticks, then admitted exactly one retained four-body volley when capacity returned.
fixture_corrections: Initial late-aim test incorrectly compared children to world north after natural pursuit had moved the parent. It now compares to the actual parent-to-player direction at Shoot.
